summary: Race condition when adding custom search attributes concurrently causes multiple search attributes with the same alias to be created, breaking visibility database queries.
userImpact: Concurrent additions of custom search attributes create duplicate aliases that break visibility database queries and prevent proper issue filtering.
rootCause: Missing optimistic concurrency control checks when creating custom search attributes
proposedFix: Add optimistic concurrency control checks to prevent race conditions during custom search attribute creation
resolutionDetails: Fixed by adding optimistic concurrency control checks (PR #10057), released in v1.32.0
keyQuote: Temporal creates multiple search attributes with the same alias (probably, because of race condition). This leads to multiple problems with queries to the visibility database.
